note: The companion to vision-is-a-prayer-target: slowness is built in, so an absent result is a turn still in progress rather than a miss. He also misdates the Kirk killing to August before correcting to September.

A specific medical prediction, a new transmitted disease, with no date and a self-selecting victim class that no epidemiology would report separately. The specificity is in the description, not in anything checkable.
The acceleration word again, now as an urgency in the air. Same content as the 2023 telling.
Unusually located: a named mountain range and door-to-door towns rather than a continent. That makes it checkable in principle, though no date is attached.
The listener's part in the march: ask to be a voice piece.
A private family matter, unverifiable from outside and left that way.
Puts the waking on the 2025 to 2026 boundary. The claim had no window before.

The canopy is the distinctive image and gets the mention; dispensation-ending is already well attested elsewhere and would otherwise take a passage that is really about the canopy. He states the link himself, so it is recorded as a brandon edge with this passage as evidence.
Contend is not defined and no subject is named, so nothing here can miss. Recorded because it is presented as a direct word about a specific year.

Worth flagging: he is correcting listeners who thought he predicted a plague now, and narrowing it to fall or winter 2027. A retroactive tightening of an earlier looser claim, which is exactly what delta rows exist to preserve.
Red dawn is named but never defined, here or anywhere yet in the corpus. Filed as its own claim so the definition can be attached if it arrives.
Pairs with taxes-lowered-then-waterfall, which has the waterfall as the thing that does happen. Here the waterfall is the thing prayer averts, so the same image runs both ways.
The 19 November prayer segment replayed inside the 18 November video. Recorded rather than skipped so the repeat count stays honest.
Distinct from antichrist-seen-2014 and the named-candidate claims: this is a description of manner, not an identification.
Which cold war is not said. Kim appears in the same breath, so a system edge links it to kim-jong-un-role, but he does not state that the cold war is the Korean one.
Extends the hearing claim to the whole audience while reserving sight to himself. Belongs with prophetic-method-in-part.
Adds the season, November to March, which the claim did not have.
His own stated standard. Recorded because it is the yardstick he offers, and this database is in a position to hold him to it.
Three names and nothing else. He does not say what the warning is, and I have not filled it in for him; the paraphrase says the pattern is implied and left unstated.
The most interesting thing in the batch as evidence about method. He reports a sight that does not match the fact, says so, and does not revise it. That is the opposite of the usual post-hoc fitting.
The key word was supplied to him by someone else in the room and he took it. Recorded as certainty hedged for that reason.
A lateness metaphor with no clock, which lets it hold indefinitely.
Same structure as the infertility word in batch 31: any large audience supplies a match.
Does double duty as a prophecy and as a pre-emptive answer to any decision the audience dislikes. Gratitude is not an observable outcome, so it is filed unfalsifiable.
